name: Data Format Converter
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Updates the TOML and YAML parsers to fix denial of service advisories.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
TOML with thousands of comment lines now converts, and deeply nested YAML shows a clear error.
tip: Select code block contents without the fences before running the convert command.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Data Format Converter is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your notes.
